Name: Defeatist
Effect: While this Pokémon is at full HP increase its Strength and Special by 1. If this Pokémon's HP is at half or less, Roll its Loyalty requiring 2 Successes every Action, if the Roll Fails Reduce by 2 its Strength and Special for that Action. If the Roll is Successful it keeps its Attributes unchanged and/or restores them if they were reduced in a previous Action.
Description: This Pokémon is a pessimist by nature. When things get difficult, it will be the first to give up.
